## Why

`search_near` sends the worker's query to Google Text Search with a location bias around the stop or stay, not a limit ([tool design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/tools.md) 2.3). That's on purpose: a query that names a farther place, such as "restaurants in Tuolumne Meadows", searches there. But a query about a style, with no place in it, such as "historic bed and breakfast inn Victorian house", can come back with places across the country. Those results are useless, and they cost the worker tokens to read. A search near a stay never needs a place hundreds of miles away.

Adding the town to every query isn't the fix. Around a stay, the best place is often in the next town: in the same session, "lobster pound lobster shack" near Bar Harbor found Trenton Bridge Lobster Pound in Trenton and Beal's Lobster Pier in Southwest Harbor, both about 9 miles out. With "Bar Harbor" in the query, Google would likely rank places in Bar Harbor itself first.

## What happened

Joe's Bar Harbor session on the live site on 2026-10-30, agent session `89f4dea6-6cb9-4320-a917-c063620acca9`, in the `road-trip-agent` project in Phoenix. Of the 14 `search_near` calls, 6 returned places more than 100 miles away:

- Turn 7, Portland lodging, "historic bed and breakfast inn Victorian house": 6 of 10 results were over 100 miles away, such as B&Bs in St. Augustine, FL, and Sioux Falls, SD, the farthest 2,704 miles.
- Turn 5, Bar Harbor lodging, "retro motel motor court inn": its only result was 1,397 miles away.
- Four more had one or two results 143 to 213 miles away, such as "espresso cafe breakfast" near Portland, and "whale watch cruise" near Bar Harbor in turn 15.

## Design

- [Tool design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/tools.md), section 2.3 (`search_near`, and "The near distance biases the search. It doesn't limit it.").
- [Google data source](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/data-sources/google.md), the Text Search row for places near a stay.
- [Technical spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/technical-spec.md), section 10 (settings, such as the near distance).

## Open questions

- ~~How far is too far? Proposal: 100 miles, as the crow flies from the search's center, as a setting in technical spec section 10. A search near a stay never needs a place that far, and it still lets through a query that names a nearby town, such as one 30 miles off.~~ Settled 2026-10-30, in chat: 100 miles, as the crow flies from the search's center, as its own setting in technical spec section 10, apart from the near distance. In the Bar Harbor session, every useful result was within about 35 miles, and every useless one was 143 miles or more. 100 miles still leaves room for a query that names a specific place an hour or more away in a remote area.

## Do

- In `search_near`, drop results farther than the cutoff, 100 miles, before building the reply. A call whose results are all dropped says it found nothing near, as a search with no results does today.
- Change `search_near`'s description to say results that far away are left out, and that a query about a style alone, such as "Victorian house", can find little nearby, so naming the area can help. The implementer drafts the wording, and Joe reviews it in the PR.
- Update tool design 2.3 and the Google data source to match, and add the setting to technical spec section 10.
- Run `npm run agent-views`, and commit the workers' view files with the change.

## Done when

- A test with a fake Google reply shows a far result dropped and a near one kept.
- `npm run check` passes.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat.
